name: Ray Transformer
aliases: Ray Transformer — A module based on linear attention that provides non-local information of other points along the ray to predict SRDF, addressing the non-local definition of SRDF.
definition: A module based on linear attention that provides non-local information of other points along the ray to predict SRDF, addressing the non-local definition of SRDF.
summary: The Ray Transformer is a linear attention module that predicts Signed Ray Distance Functions by aggregating non-local information along viewing rays, addressing SRDF's non-local definition.
